basic_details.short_information: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya (ANDUAT), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 15 posts in 12 roles under Advt No. 15/2026. The posts include Assistant Professor (Aquatic Environment Management), Assistant Professor (Aquaculture), Assistant Professor (Fisheries Processing Technology), Assistant Professor (Fisheries Resource Management) and 8 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: 2 Assistant Professor (Aquatic Environment Management), 1 Assistant Professor (Aquaculture), 1 Assistant Professor (Fisheries Processing Technology), 1 Assistant Professor (Fisheries Resource Management), 2 Assistant Professor (Post Harvest Technology), 2 Assistant Professor (Floriculture & Landscaping) and 6 more posts.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: Academic Scale (Level 10) with rationalized entry pay of Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Aquatic Environment Management), Academic Scale (Level 10) with rationalized entry pay of Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Aquaculture), Academic Scale (Level 10) with rationalized entry pay of Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Fisheries Processing Technology), Academic Scale (Level 10) with rationalized entry pay of Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Fisheries Resource Management), Academic Scale (Level 10) with rationalized entry pay of Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Post Harvest Technology).
